title: The first night
steps: The common room is very quiet, with a warm fire crackling in the fireplace, a round rug, and a doorway on each side to a dormitory.
These are the first-years' rooms. {The girls sleep on the left, the boys on the right|The boys sleep on the left, the girls on the right}, and you all share this common room.
Tomorrow is a long day. Good night to the three of you, and I will see you in the morning.
Goodnight, {wizard}. I am so sleepy! I will see you tomorrow.
Ilda goes out through the door and closes it behind her, and her steps go away down the corridor. {friend} crosses the doorway on the left into the other dormitory and stops by a bed.
You cross the doorway on the right into your dormitory, between the beds. By the first bed, under the window, someone is waiting for you.
Hello, I am {mate}. I think we share this dormitory! This bed by the window is mine, and I think yours is the one right beside it. What is your name?
I am {wizard}. I am very glad to meet you and to share the room, but I am so tired!

{mate} goes to the first bed, slips under the sheet and falls asleep. In the other dormitory {friend} is asleep already. You are tired too, and your bed is the next one: to sleep in a bed, you stand beside the trunk at its foot.
